candidates.name: Psw
candidates.description: PSW’s diverse portfolio includes successful management of delegated risk contracts, launching a Medicare Advantage plan, standing up a national leading ACO and building the infrastructure to manage population health across all payer models. Recognized for our collaborative approach, PSW seeks to meet our partners ‘where they are’ with a focus on engagement, data analytics and creating value for stakeholders. As an early adopter of moving population health to volume-to-value, PSW’s collective knowledge delivers the right tools and resources to ensure high-quality healthcare that is cost effective and drives successful patient outcomes.
candidates.rationale: Healthcare population-health services/ACO operator, not a software platform for independent primary care practices.

candidates.name: On Belay Health Solutions
candidates.description: At On Belay, we believe that fixing healthcare starts with primary care. That’s why we are supporting primary care teams in delivering the best possible care for all their patients, while also ensuring their own well-being and sustainability. A strong and vibrant practice means better patient health and experience.
candidates.rationale: Both target independent primary care practices with care-management/value-based care support; same buyer persona and adjacent offering.

candidates.name: Better Health Group
candidates.description: Better Health Group, an industry-leading primary care value-based organization, is on a mission to transform sick care into better healthcare. Over the last two decades, we’ve grown from one rural clinic to a value-based network that’s ranked among the top 5% nationwide in Medicare. We equip primary care providers with the tools, insights, and processes they need to practice better medicine and run better businesses. We currently partner with nearly 700 owned and independent clinics to deliver 5-star outcomes to more than 312K+ patients across six states for Medicare Advantage, Traditional Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial payers. Our network of owned clinics, VIPcare, has used a proven senior care model focused on prevention and maintenance to deliver high-quality care and 5-star service to Medicare Advantage communities across 6 states. Together, Better Health Group’s lines of service work to realize our mission to transform sick care into Better Health care.
candidates.rationale: Different role in the market: Better Health Group is a value-based care provider/network, while Aledade is a software/platform vendor for practices and ACOs.

candidates.name: Advanced Management USA
candidates.description: Advanced Management USA helps independent physicians succeed in value-based care through MSSP and ACO REACH. Managing and owning some of the best-performing ACOs in the country, we operate across 30+ states and counting. With proven results, hands-on consulting, and innovative technology, we help practices improve outcomes, reduce costs, and thrive in today’s healthcare landscape.
candidates.rationale: Both enable independent physician practices in value-based care via MSSP/ACO REACH and ACO operations, targeting similar primary care/ACO buyer personas.

candidates.name: Innovista Health Solutions
candidates.description: Helping providers succeed in value-based care by developing strong relationships, delivering innovative solutions, and driving exceptional performance. Innovista Health was founded to enable physicians to engage, support, and manage value-based savings and shared-risk models. Innovista combines deep industry experience, focused technology, and innovative programs to deliver a timely, turn-key solution for healthcare providers, health plans, and strategic partners.
candidates.rationale: Both are US value-based care enablement platforms serving physicians, providers, and ACO-like customers with similar buyer needs.

candidates.name: Prime Care Managers
candidates.description: PCM IS A NETWORK OF PRIMARY CARE PHYSICIANS DEDICATED TO PROVIDING INNOVATIVE HEALTH MANAGEMENT SOLUTIONS AND VALUE TO OUR PAYER AND PATIENT PARTNERS. We believe other more traditional forms of healthcare delivery are too expensive and economically unsustainable. The PCM model brings fully informed, primary care driven patient centric coordination to health care; a contrast to a historically fragmented, wasteful and uncoordinated medical culture. HOW PCM WORKS PCM's mission is on improved and informed decisions and choices to reduce duplication, unnecessary care and cost to those that pay for the care. PCM’S MISSION IS ACHIEVED WITH SOLUTION-DRIVEN, MANAGED SERVICE LINES: • Care Coordination • Early Identification • Stratification of Probable Medical Risks • Care Plan Intervention • Connect Providers Across the Continuum • Care Gaps Bridge THE RESULT: To improve the overall health and well being of the patient.
candidates.rationale: Primary care network and care management service, not a value-based care enablement platform competing with Aledade.

candidates.name: Pathways Health Partners
candidates.description: Pathways Health Partners was developed in an effort to help tackle the challenges facing healthcare today. We deploy integrated capabilities for Value-Based success. Care Management: Focus your care management efforts where they can have the greatest impact on health outcomes. Our technology platform predicts which patients are most likely to experience serious, preventable medical episodes Analytics: Measure real-time performance, cost, risk and productivity against strategy and goals to prevent unnecessary spending. Risk Stratification: Focus your resources where they will have the greatest impact. Analytics: Measure real-time performance, cost, risk, and productivity against strategy and goals to prevent unnecessary spending. Risk Stratification: Focus your resources where they will have the greatest impact. Close the GAP: Identify the Care GAP that are impacting your Quality Scores. With the increased momentum in Value-over-Volume Quality scores are crucial to business performance.
candidates.rationale: Same value-based care enablement niche for healthcare providers; similar customer base and buyer persona.

candidates.name: MCM Accountable Care Organization
candidates.description: MCM Accountable Care Organization LLC is a physician owned and operated organization. MCMACO was established to improve healthcare delivery based on the Accountable Care Organization (ACO) principle; the three part aim of improving patient experience, improving population health, and decreasing per capita healthcare costs. MCMACO will establish, define, implement, evaluate, and periodically update each ACO component by promoting: 1) Beneficiary Engagement 2) Evidenced based medicine 3) Care Plan Coordination 4) Internal Quality and Cost Metrics Reporting and Improvement.
candidates.rationale: ACO organization, likely a customer/participant in Aledade's market, not a comparable value-based care platform vendor.

candidates.name: Privia Health
candidates.description: Privia Health™ is a national physician platform transforming the healthcare delivery experience. We provide tailored solutions for physicians and providers, creating value and securing their future. Through high-performance physician groups, accountable care organizations, and population health management programs, Privia works in partnership with health plans, health systems, and employers to better align reimbursements to quality and outcomes. All communications related to jobs at Privia Health or its affiliates will come from a priviahealth.com email address. If you have concerns with the legitimacy of a position please contact Talent@priviahealth.com or call Privia Health HR at 571-366-8850.
candidates.rationale: Both are physician-focused value-based care platforms serving primary care practices, ACOs, and population health programs.

candidates.name: DataQ Health
candidates.description: At DataQ Health, we harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize patient care by providing advanced tools to make informed decisions in a value-based care landscape. With our comprehensive suite of services and solutions, DataQ Health is ready to meet the unique needs of the healthcare industry.
candidates.rationale: Both provide technology/platform solutions supporting value-based care decision-making for healthcare providers; overlapping buyer persona in primary care/health systems.
